annotations.title: Compare Sole Trader And Limited Company

description: Compare the tax and take-home of trading in the UK as a sole trader against a limited company, at a given profit. An estimate for the current UK tax year. Needs no account.

company.description: Which company to read, by name or id, when the account has more than one (see list_companies). Leave it out to use the only company, or the default.

extra_running_costs.description: Extra yearly costs of running a company (accountant, software), in pounds, if known.

profit.description: Annual profit before tax, in pounds.
